correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the weight-zero identity for A=K⊕V with V²=0 and finite dim V=n≥1. Writing P(1)=a+u, P(v)=f(v)+L(v), scalar parts at (v,v) give f(v)²=2f(v)², forcing f=0 over any field; similarly (1,1) forces a=0. Then (1,v) gives L²=0; (1,1) gives 2L(u)=0. Conversely xP(y)+P(x)y∈V and P of this equals 2abL(u), so both constraints suffice. Thus P²(a+v)=aL(u), P³=0; characteristic two admits index 3 iff L(u)≠0; other characteristics require P²=0. Square-zero maps of rank r correspond to im U⊂ker W of dimensions r,n-r and an isomorphism V/W→U, proving M_q(n,r); each u-stratum follows from im L⊂ker L. Independent brute force over F2,n=2 enumerated all 2^9 linear maps, checked all basis-pair identities, found 16 RB maps with index counts 1,9,6. Full source result and verify.py were inspected, not merely log outputs.
